title: 美债收益率高企：贝森特购债规模仅20亿，能否压住收益率？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Okay, we touched on what Scott Bessent's and that side of the room is doing.
segments.zh: 我们谈到了斯科特·贝森特那边的动作。

segments.en: I want to get your thoughts on whether or not you think that works, whether...
segments.zh: 我想听听你的看法，你觉得这招管用吗？

segments.en: I mean, certainly when you look at the absolute level on Treasury yields in the shape of the curve, it doesn't look like this is an economy that's slowing down.
segments.zh: 从美债收益率绝对水平和曲线形态看，经济似乎并未放缓。

segments.en: And I'm wondering whether Scott Bessent, there's simply trying to abstract maybe some of the premium and supply issues
segments.zh: 我在想，贝森特是否在试图规避一些供应和溢价问题。

segments.en: that are hounding the Treasury market. Effectively, when I want to ask you, do you think the exercise to cap yields will help?
segments.zh: 这些问题正困扰着美债市场。你觉得限制收益率有用吗？

segments.en: And do you think the Treasury curve is representative currently at the underlying economy?
segments.zh: 你认为当前美债曲线能反映经济基本面吗？

segments.en: So I think right now the Treasury curve is exaggerating the underlying health of the economy, given the disinflationary winds that we're seeing blowing.
segments.zh: 我认为当前美债曲线高估了经济健康度，因为通缩压力仍在。

segments.en: That says you are absolutely correct. There is a ton of corporate bond market supply coming online record levels here
segments.zh: 你说得对，企业债供应量巨大，创纪录水平。

segments.en: and in the months to come throughout the end of the year.
segments.zh: 未来几个月乃至年底前都是如此。

segments.en: And the term premium is sky high as you note.
segments.zh: 而且期限溢价高得离谱，正如你所说。

segments.en: So whether or not this is going to be effective, we will find out.
segments.zh: 所以，这一政策是否有效，我们拭目以待。

segments.en: Purchases don't begin until September the 9th. And whether or not Bessent has backed himself into a corner where he has to go from 2 billion to 4 billion a month
segments.zh: 购买要到9月9日才开始。贝森特是否已将自己逼入绝境，不得不将月度购买规模从20亿提高到40亿，

segments.en: to potentially 8 billion a month, remains to be seen because right now, the bond market vigilantes have certainly called his bluff.
segments.zh: 甚至可能达到80亿，这还有待观察，因为目前债券市场的“义警”显然已看穿了他的虚张声势。
